newsitem.title: LIBYA: Gaddafi opens Sahara group summit in Libya.
newsitem.headline: Gaddafi opens Sahara group summit in Libya.

text.p: Libyan leader Muammar Gaddafi on Friday opened a summit with Chad, Niger, Mali and Burkina Faso to discuss closer ties in the region.
The five heads of state met behind closed doors, Libyan officials said. The summit would end on Sunday.
The four visiting leaders were Chad's Idriss Deby, Burkina Faso's Blaise Compaore, Niger's Ibrahim Barre Mainassara and Mali President Alpha Oumar Konare.
Gaddafi proposed that the five countries bordering the Sahara form a regional grouping.
He also said that his country would open its ports to the four countries giving them access to the Mediterranean.
